fusions.name: Spoken Bolt
fusions.desc: Speaks a bolt of force into the first enemy in its path, dealing 8 damage. Holds 4 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rote Command
fusions.desc: Bleats a word of command, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Quickened Recital
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Drilled Routine
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
